sloka: कच्चित् सर्वे ऽनुरक्तास्त्वां कुलपुत्रा: प्रधानत: ।कच्चित्प्राणांस्तवार्थेषु सन्त्यजन्ति समाहिता: ॥ २.१००.३५॥
transliteration: kaccit sarve 'nuraktāstvāṁ kulaputrā: pradhānata: ।kaccitprāṇāṁstavārtheṣu santyajanti samāhitā: ॥ 2.100.35॥

translations.english: O Bharata, I hope you have chosen as your envoy an expert born in your own country, wellinformed, skilful and quick to understand one who repeats and reports (exactly) what has been told.
